Topic 5.3: Marketing of Goods and Services

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Marketing of Goods and Services
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is the market of goods and services selected?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the importance of marketing to a business
2. recognise suitable markets for goods and services

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain the importance of marketing to a business

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain the importance of marketing to a business.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “explain the importance of marketing to a business” using a school example.
• Model B for “explain the importance of marketing to a business” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "explain the importance of marketing to a business" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: recognise suitable markets for goods and services

Teach
• Today’s focus: recognise suitable markets for goods and services.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “recognise suitable markets for goods and services” using a school example.
• Model B for “recognise suitable markets for goods and services” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recognise suitable markets for goods and services" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain the importance of marketing to a business
• Model 2: recognise suitable markets for goods and services

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain the importance of marketing to a business
2. Practise: recognise suitable markets for goods and services

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Marketing of Goods and Services.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the market of goods and services selected?
2. Where can information about the market and its potential customers be sourced from?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the importance of marketing to a business
• recognise suitable markets for goods and services

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
